title: LEAP Stacks 2
description: Launch Gen AI apps on AWS with one click

explainers.name: S3 (Simple Storage Service)
explainers.description: Amazon S3 is an object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance. It can be used to store and protect any amount of data for various use cases.
explainers.pricing: Standard Tier: ~$0.023 per GB/month. Free Tier: 5GB of standard storage for 12 months.

explainers.name: Welcome
explainers.description: Welcome to the LEAP environment. This platform helps you rapidly prototype and deploy Generative AI solutions using AWS services.

explainers.name: Lambda
explainers.description: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that runs your code in response to events and automatically manages the underlying compute resources.
explainers.pricing: Standard: $0.20 per 1M requests + $0.0000166667 per GB-second. Free Tier: 400,000 GB-seconds/month (always free).

explainers.name: API Gateway
explainers.description: Amazon API Gateway is a fully managed service that makes it easy to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure APIs at any scale.
explainers.pricing: REST APIs: ~$3.50 per million calls. HTTP APIs: ~$1.00 per million calls. Free Tier: 1 million calls/month for 12 months.

explainers.name: Amazon Bedrock
explainers.description: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed service that offers high-performing foundation models (FMs) from leading AI companies through a single API.
explainers.pricing: On-Demand pricing varies by model (e.g., Claude 3 Haiku: ~$0.00025/1k input tokens). No permanent free tier.

explainers.name: Knowledge Base
explainers.description: A centralized repository of organized information used to enhance the accuracy and relevance of AI responses via RAG.
explainers.pricing: Vector storage costs apply (e.g., OpenSearch Serverless). Sync: $0.10 per GB of data ingestion.

explainers.name: Agents
explainers.description: AI Agents are autonomous programs that perceive their environment and take actions to achieve specific goals by interacting with external services.

explainers.name: Prompt Engineering
explainers.description: The practice of designing and optimizing input prompts for AI language models to generate more accurate and relevant responses.

explainers.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation
explainers.description: An AI architecture combining information retrieval with text generation to improve accuracy by using a knowledge base.

explainers.name: Amazon EC2
explainers.description: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) provides scalable computing capacity in the AWS Cloud.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 750 hours/month (t2.micro/t3.micro). On-Demand: Starts at ~$0.0116/hour.

explainers.name: AWS Amplify
explainers.description: A set of tools and services that enables developers to build secure, scalable full-stack applications.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 1,000 build minutes & 5GB storage/month. Pay-as-you-go: $0.01/build minute.

explainers.name: AWS CloudFormation
explainers.description: Infrastructure as Code service to model, provision, and manage AWS resources.
explainers.pricing: Free for AWS namespace resources. Custom resources: $0.0009 per operation after free tier.

explainers.name: Bedrock AgentCore
explainers.description: The agentic platform within Bedrock for building and deploying autonomous agents that execute complex tasks.
explainers.pricing: Charged based on model inference and Knowledge Base storage/retrieval costs.

explainers.name: AWS CodeBuild
explainers.description: A fully managed continuous integration service that compiles source code, runs tests, and produces software packages.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 100 build minutes/month. General1.small: $0.005/min (~$0.30/hour).

explainers.name: Amazon DynamoDB
explainers.description: A serverless, key-value NoSQL database designed for high-performance applications at any scale.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 25GB storage, 25 WCU, 25 RCU (always free). On-demand: ~$1.25/million writes.

explainers.name: Systems Manager Automation
explainers.description: Simplifies common maintenance and deployment tasks of AWS resources via automated runbooks.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 100,000 steps/month. Afterward: $0.002 per step.

explainers.name: Strands
explainers.description: An open source, lightweight framework for defining agentic workflows and connecting orchestrators to inference APIs.
explainers.pricing: Open source (free). Underlying model usage costs apply.

explainers.name: Model Context Protocol
explainers.description: An open standard enabling AI models to interact securely with external data and tools via standardized context requests.
explainers.pricing: Open standard (free). Infrastructure costs depend on hosting implementation.

explainers.name: Amazon Cognito
explainers.description: Provides authentication, authorization, and user management for web and mobile apps, supporting millions of users.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 50,000 MAUs for User Pools (always free). Next tier: $0.0055 per MAU.

explainers.name: Amazon CloudFront
explainers.description: A global Content Delivery Network (CDN) that speeds up the distribution of static and dynamic web content to users via edge locations.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 1 TB of data transfer out to the internet per month. Paid: Regional data transfer rates apply (e.g., $0.085/GB).

explainers.name: AWS Free Tier
explainers.description: The AWS Free Tier provides customers the ability to explore and try out AWS services free of charge up to specified limits. It includes 12-Month Free, Always Free, and Short-term trials.
explainers.pricing: Free up to specified limits (e.g., 750 hours EC2, 5GB S3, 25GB DynamoDB).

explainers.name: AWS Cost Explorer
explainers.description: AWS Cost Explorer is a tool that enables you to view and analyze your costs and usage. You can visualize data, view trends, and forecast future spending.
explainers.pricing: User Interface is free. API requests cost $0.01 per request. Hourly granularity costs $0.01 per 1,000 usage records.

explainers.name: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
explainers.description: AWS IAM enables you to securely control access to AWS services and resources. You can create and manage AWS users and groups, and use permissions to allow and deny their access to AWS resources.
explainers.pricing: IAM is a feature of your AWS account offered at no additional charge.

explainers.name: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS)
explainers.description: Amazon EFS provides a simple, serverless, set-and-forget, elastic file system. It automatically grows and shrinks as you add and remove files with no need for management or provisioning.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 5GB of Standard storage for 12 months. Standard Storage: $0.30 per GB-month. Infrequent Access: $0.016 per GB-month.

explainers.name: Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR)
explainers.description: Amazon ECR is a fully managed container registry that makes it easy to store, manage, share, and deploy your container images and artifacts anywhere.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 500MB of storage/month for 1 year. Standard: $0.10 per GB/month for storage + data transfer rates.

explainers.name: Kiro
explainers.description: Kiro is an AI-powered coding environment built by AWS that uses 'spec-driven development' to turn ideas into clear plans before writing code. It offers an agentic IDE experience similar to Cursor but with a focus on structured specifications.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 50 credits/month (perpetual). Pro: $20/month (1,000 credits). Pro+: $40/month (2,000 credits). Pay-as-you-go overages: $0.04/credit.

explainers.name: n8n
explainers.description: n8n is an extendable workflow automation tool that enables you to connect anything to everything via a visual node-based editor. It is fair-code distributed and can be self-hosted or used via their cloud offering.
explainers.pricing: Self-Hosted: Free (Community Edition). Cloud Starter: ~$20/month (2.5k executions). Cloud Pro: ~$50/month (10k executions).

explainers.name: Lovable
explainers.description: Lovable is an AI-powered full-stack app builder that turns natural language descriptions into fully functional web applications. It emphasizes UI/UX design and rapid prototyping.
explainers.pricing: Free Tier: 5 daily credits (public projects only). Pro: $25/month (100 monthly credits + private projects). Business: $50/month (SSO, data opt-out).

explainers.name: Replit AI
explainers.description: Replit AI is an embedded AI coding assistant within the Replit online IDE. It features an autonomous 'Agent' that can plan, build, and deploy applications from natural language prompts.
explainers.pricing: Starter: Free (limited Agent trial, public apps). Core: $20/month ($25 monthly credits, private apps). Teams: $35/user/month.
